sections.title: Public information review
sections.sub: Prepared for Mr. Vũ Trung Thành | 3 October 2026
sections.body:
Reputation review
and action proposal

Aurant has reviewed public reporting and professional references associated with Mr. Vũ Trung Thành, DigiLend and his former VietinBank roles. This brief sets out the evidence, correction opportunities and a proposed programme for search visibility and public information accuracy.

117documented exposure items
18additions to the saved baseline
64distinct hostnames
Proposed engagement: 90 calendar days. Initial evidence review: 10 business days. Commercial terms are for discussion and are not an agreed contract.

The register includes original reports, publisher copies, aggregator pages, print material, public profiles and one video. It is a documented sample of accessible material, not a count of the entire internet.

Confidential working proposal

Prepared for private review. Statements about legal proceedings are attributed to their sources. A certified judgment and any later decisions are required before Aurant submits claims about exoneration or the current legal position.

sections.title: Findings and scope
sections.sub: What is established and what needs documentary confirmation
sections.body:
Coverage classificationItemsMeaning
Adverse legal reporting88Xuyên Việt Oil investigation, trial or later case reporting
Critical business coverage8Business and financial context, including copies
Mixed coverage3Arrest profiles with favorable career descriptions
Positive or promotional5Company statements, appointments and professional activity
Neutral background13Career, corporate and registry references
Total117Publication exposures, not independent allegations

Aurant therefore identifies 99 adverse, critical or mixed items in this register. This is a coverage classification, not a finding that 99 items are false, defamatory or removable.

Immediate priorities

Confirm the legal record. Correct identity mismatches. Separate proposed sentences from judgments. Check for statements that confuse a suspended sentence with imprisonment served. Update professional information with verified dates and titles.

Research boundary

The initial saved report contained 99 items. This edition adds 18 items, including the two URLs identified in the subsequent chat. Existing source IDs remain unchanged. Known aliases are excluded from the total and listed separately. The count of independent stories or legally separate publishers has not been established.

No evidence supports a claim that 500 or 1,000 relevant adverse posts have already been found. Search engine result estimates are not used as counts.

sections.title: Xuyên Việt Oil reporting
sections.sub: Chronology and distinctions that matter in a correction request
sections.body:
PeriodPublic record reviewedInterpretation
March 2024Reports identify Thanh as the VietinBank Thanh Xuân branch director and describe arrest and prosecution. [S002]Investigation stage. Do not treat the arrest date as a conviction date.
November 2024Prosecution recommendations include a suspended sentence. [S113]A recommendation and the court’s decision are distinct.
29 November 2024The Court Journal reports that HCMC People’s Court imposed two years and six months, suspended, for giving bribes. [S016]A suspended sentence is not an acquittal. This is reporting of the first instance outcome.
8 May 2025Tuyên Quang covers seven appellants and repeats Thanh’s first instance sentence. [S114]Thanh is absent from that article’s list of seven appellants. It does not establish that he appealed or was exonerated.

Court identity

The reported first instance court is HCMC People’s Court. References to the Supreme People’s Procuracy or the Court Journal’s institutional affiliation should not be rewritten as a Supreme People’s Court judgment against Thanh.

Document request

Obtain the certified first instance judgment, any appeal or later review decision concerning Thanh, and any official correction or annulment. Verify the exact findings, sentence, effective date and any continuing restrictions with Vietnamese counsel.

The account that Thanh was never sentenced is not supported by the reporting reviewed. If later documents change the position, they should lead every correction request. Aurant should not publish an exoneration statement before this is resolved.

sections.title: Identity and other matters
sections.sub: Keep the professional biography and case attribution precise
sections.body:
Professional background

DigiLend’s company page names Vũ Trung Thành as a founder. Its company feed describes him as CEO. VietnamNet’s September 2026 coverage describes him as founder, chairman and general director. These are attributed descriptions; current appointments should be supported by company records. [S044] [S045] [S062]

Historical reporting describes a VietinBank Securities CEO role followed by branch management appointments. It does not establish that he was CEO of the entire VietinBank group. The precise current PGBank strategic adviser role remains unverified in this review. [S056]

Separate criminal or civil proceedings

Targeted searches combining his name with legal proceedings and DigiLend did not establish a separate case involving this same person beyond Xuyên Việt Oil. This is a limited research finding, not a certificate that no other proceedings exist.

Business coverage

VietnamNet discusses DigiLend investment offers advertised at up to 12.5% a year. This is a separate business reporting theme, not evidence of a separate criminal case or proof of fraud. Product claims, contracts and regulatory descriptions should be checked before preparing a response. [S062]

Apparent identity mismatch

A Người Quan Sát profile for an NDF food company executive born in 1971 displays a related article about the VietinBank banker. That appears to be an incorrect association and is a practical first correction candidate. Request removal of the association after confirming identifiers. It does not establish that the underlying banker article is false. [X01]

No live Google AI Overview citing that profile was captured. Its possible effect on AI identity matching is a hypothesis, not an observed result.

sections.title: Correction and removal priorities
sections.sub: An evidence pack for each disputed claim
sections.body:
PriorityActionEvidence and intended result
1. Identity errorAsk the profile publisher to detach an unrelated article.Profile occupation and birth year, correct biography and the exact related link. [X01]
2. Incorrect legal wordingIdentify the exact inaccurate sentence and propose a narrow correction.Certified judgment and later decisions. Correct charge, sentence, court, date or legal status.
3. Missing later outcomeAsk for an update or editor’s note if a verified later decision changes the position.Official later decision and a concise chronology. No blanket claim that old coverage was false.
4. Syndicated copiesTrace each original and copy, then send the relevant correction evidence.Original article, copy URL, disputed text and approved correction. Each copy requires verification.
5. Search remnantsRequest a refresh after deletion or a material source change.Before and after captures, working source URL and the obsolete search text. [P02]
6. Legal or policy breachHave the client or authorized representative use the applicable process.Specific URL, statement, supporting facts and legal basis where required. [P03]

Each case record should contain the source ID, author or publisher, publication date when available, captured passage, evidence of the error, requested remedy, approved sender, submission date, reply and final status.

Accurate historical reporting may remain published. A correction, contextual update, source deletion, search delisting and a country specific restriction are different outcomes and must be reported separately.

sections.title: Search suppression and AI Overviews
sections.sub: Improve the accuracy and visibility of verified information
sections.body:
Search suppression

The proposed SEO work aims to improve the visibility of useful, accurate professional information for agreed name queries. It cannot delete a publisher’s page or guarantee that a particular article moves off the first page.

WorkstreamPractical workMeasurement
Verified biographyOne authoritative biography with dated roles, primary references and consistent identity information.Publication, indexing status and visibility for agreed name queries.
Professional contentSubstantive interviews, expertise articles and real business updates approved by the client.Quality, relevance and search visibility; no invented achievements.
Website and profilesImprove crawl access, page titles, internal links and consistency across legitimate profiles.Technical fixes and verified profile accuracy.
Independent coveragePitch genuinely newsworthy activity to relevant publications.Editorial interest and resulting coverage; publication is not guaranteed.

AI Overview correction

Capture the exact query, date, language, country setting, answer and cited URLs. Identify the inaccurate claim, correct its source where possible, then submit specific feedback with evidence. Repeat the same query set to check whether the claim changes. [P04, P07]

Google says normal SEO practices apply to AI features and no special AI markup is required. A supporting page must be indexed and eligible for a snippet. Source owners can use noindex or snippet controls for their own pages; Aurant cannot apply them to another publisher’s site. Recrawling can take days to months. [P01]

The report does not contain a measured Google ranking or AI Overview baseline. Establishing that baseline is a first phase deliverable. No agency can directly edit Google’s generated answer.

sections.title: Delivery schedule
sections.sub: A 90 calendar day pilot with defined decision points
sections.body:
The schedule begins after agreement, appointment of an authorized client contact and receipt of the initial evidence pack. Business days apply to Aurant preparation work; external response times are outside Aurant’s control.

WindowAurant deliverableDependency
Business days 1 to 3Confirm identity, documents, scope and a fixed set of 10 search queries.Client documents and access to owned properties.
Business days 4 to 10Refresh up to 150 candidate URLs; capture search and AI baselines; prioritize initial cases.Accessible sources and sufficient identity evidence.
Calendar days 11 to 30Prepare and, after authorization, submit up to five active correction cases; publish the approved biography.Evidence review and client signoff.
Calendar days 31 to 60Follow up, address verified copies, refresh changed sources and publish substantive content.Publisher responses, source changes and editorial approval.
Calendar days 61 to 90Repeat measurements, document outcomes, resolve open work and propose the next phase.No assumption that search changes are complete by day 90.

Expected timing versus commitment

Allow an initial 2 to 6 week follow up cycle for publisher requests as an Aurant planning assumption, not a publisher service standard. Some requests may take longer or be declined. Source refresh and AI changes have no fixed completion date. SEO should be evaluated at 90 days and may need 3 to 6 months or longer; this is a planning horizon, not a promised ranking result.

Client checkpoints

Day 10: approve the priority list. Day 30: review requests and published assets. Day 60: assess early outcomes. Day 90: decide whether to extend, narrow or close the programme.

sections.title: Reporting and accountability
sections.sub: Measure completed work and observed changes
sections.body:
MeasureHow Aurant will record it
DiscoveryNew relevant URLs, duplicate URLs, aliases and excluded namesakes.
CorrectionsRequested, accepted, partly accepted, declined or awaiting response. Exact text before and after.
RemovalSource deletion verified separately from search delisting. Date, jurisdiction and affected URL.
Search visibilityThe same 10 queries and first 20 organic results, with date, language, location setting and device context.
AI accuracyWhether an Overview appeared, exact disputed claims, cited pages and later observations.
Content deliveryApproved assets published, outstanding client approvals and measured indexing status.
Commercial controlHours used, active case count, outside costs and changes to scope.

Reporting cadence

Weekly checks during the contracted pilot and a monthly client report. A material verified new claim should be flagged in the agreed business hours response window. Continuous monitoring is not currently running and would begin only under an agreed engagement.

Client responsibilities

Provide legal documents, confirm roles and dates, authorize any representative, approve factual statements and nominate one contact. Vietnamese legal advice and legal filings should be handled by appropriately qualified counsel.

No publisher messages, complaints, platform reports, legal filings or payments have been made during this research. The report prepares a reviewable plan; it does not record removal outcomes.

sections.title: Source map and research method
sections.sub: How the evidence register should be used
sections.body:
Source IDs S001 to S099 preserve the earlier register. S100 to S117 are additions. English labels are Aurant summaries, not quotations of headlines. Classifications reflect how a publication presents the subject and are not findings of malicious intent.

Source groupExamplesHandling
News and specialist publicationsVnExpress, Tuổi Trẻ, Thanh Niên, VietnamPlus, Court Journal, CANDCheck stage of proceedings, attribution and the precise statement concerning Thanh.
Distribution and copiesBáo Mới, 24HMoney, syndicated publisher pagesCount separate exposures but do not call them independent allegations.
Owned and professional referencesDigiLend, LinkedIn, historical bank documentsUse as attributed background and verify current titles separately.
Public videoTOÀN CẢNH 24H on YouTubeTitle and description reviewed. Full video, comments and reposts remain separate research tasks.
Registry and profile databasesCorporate registry aggregators and executive profilesCheck stale entries and namesake associations before use.

Validation level

The register uses retrieved page text or search excerpts containing relevant mentions. Not every page was fully read or captured as a screenshot. Full publisher contact verification and legal review of each item remain delivery work. Earlier snapshots are retained; dates of publication are not inferred from search engine crawl dates.

Deduplication

Exact repeat URLs are removed. Known AMP, legacy domain and migrated URL aliases are grouped where identified. A print edition or genuinely separate publisher copy may remain a separate exposure. Independent story clusters require further manual checking.

All 117 counted source links follow in Appendix A. Appendix B lists policy references, international price pages and the apparent identity mismatch. Appendix C retains identified aliases without adding them to the count.

sections.title: Additional exposure and access limits
sections.sub: Expanded discovery scope and commercial proposal
sections.body:
Coverage not yet complete

Facebook groups, private accounts, Zalo conversations, inaccessible posts, deleted pages, complete video transcripts and comments were not comprehensively reviewed. No exhaustive social post count is available. Public social searches produced limited results, which is not evidence that no posts exist.

Search terms for further collection

Vietnamese queriesAdditional combinations
“Vũ Trung Thành” “Xuyên Việt Oil”“Vu Trung Thanh” “Xuyen Viet Oil”
“Vũ Trung Thành” “VietinBank”“Vũ Trung Thành” “Thanh Xuân”
“Vũ Trung Thành” “Chương Dương”“Vũ Trung Thành” “án treo”
“Vũ Trung Thành” “khởi tố”“Vũ Trung Thành” “phúc thẩm”
“Vũ Trung Thành” “DigiLend”“Vũ Trung Thành” “PGBank”

Use these terms in Facebook Posts and Videos, YouTube, LinkedIn and public web search. Review associated oil case headlines even when Thanh is mentioned only in the article body. Match employer, role and chronology before adding an item. Retain a direct post URL and capture date; do not count comments as independent articles.

Expansion option

The pilot covers a refresh of up to 150 candidate URLs. A larger audit of up to 500 candidates should be a separately priced work package, with discovery time and a review limit stated in the contract. It is not a commitment to find 500 relevant posts.

This section preserves the earlier report’s additional exposure and access limitations. The following page sets out proposed Aurant fees and sourced international comparisons.

sections.sub: No agreed fee and no guaranteed removal volume
sections.body:
Proposed Aurant scopeFee in VNDIncluded work
Initial audit and setup15,000,000 onceRefresh up to 150 candidate URLs, 10 query baseline and initial action list.
Monthly implementation20,000,000 per monthUp to 40 hours across research, content, correction management and reporting.
90 day pilot total75,000,000Setup plus three monthly implementation periods.

Monthly scope: up to five active correction cases at one time, four substantive approved content pieces, weekly checks and one monthly report, within the shared 40 hour allowance. Work beyond the allowance requires a scope adjustment. A case means one publisher request concerning agreed URLs; copies at other publishers may require separate cases.

These are Aurant proposal figures, not a verified Vietnam market average. Fees, taxes, payment schedule and final scope remain for discussion. Legal counsel, certified records, translation, litigation, paid media, paid data, hosting and subcontractors are excluded unless specifically agreed. Do not add a separate success fee for work already included without a written agreement.

Published international examples

ProviderAdvertised priceApplicability
ReviewPoint [P05]From USD 599 per successful removalProvider starting price; eligibility and final quote required. Suppression scoped separately.
RetainTrust [P06]USD 750 to 1,500 per successful review removalReview removal, not a quote for Vietnamese news articles.

Prices checked 3 October 2026. These providers have not assessed this case and are not endorsed or engaged by Aurant. Google or publisher decisions cannot be purchased through the service fee. No total budget is derived by multiplying these prices by every URL.

Approval sought for a scoped service programme, not a promise to erase accurate court reporting or control Google AI Overviews.

How to interpret the total

117 means 117 retained publication exposures in this report. It does not mean 117 news agencies, 117 unique original stories, 117 court findings, 117 defamatory statements or 117 items eligible for removal.

The identity mismatch reference X01 is excluded from the subject’s exposure count because the underlying biography belongs to an apparent namesake. Its erroneous related link remains a correction candidate.

Some additional URLs may remain undiscovered. Every future update should add an evidence record, check identity and duplicates, and revise the count transparently.
